ValidationRule.description: Enforces role-based Contract Bid stage changes per access matrix. Automation/DocuSign target stages allowed without manual stage permission. Bypass for integration users.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(Stage__c), NOT($Permission.Bypass_Bid_Stage_Validation), NOT($Permission.Change_Bid_Stage_All), OR( AND( $Permission.Change_Bid_Stage_Lead, NOT($Permission.Change_Bid_Stage_RM), NOT( OR( AND( OR( ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Stage__c), "Contact Made"), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Stage__c), "Information Verified") ), OR( ISPICKVAL(Stage__c, "Contract Requested"), ISPICKVAL(Stage__c, "Information Verified") ) ), AND( ISPICKVAL(Stage__c, "Closed - LOST"), NOT(ISBLANK(Lost_Reason__c)) ) ) ) ), AND( NOT($Permission.Change_Bid_Stage_Lead), NOT($Permission.Change_Bid_Stage_RM), NOT( OR( ISPICKVAL(Stage__c, "Contract Sent via DocuSign"), ISPICKVAL(Stage__c, "Proposal/Review"), ISPICKVAL(Stage__c, "Closed - WON"), ISPICKVAL(Stage__c, "Closed - LOST") ) ) ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You cannot change Contract Bid Stage for your role. Leads: Contact Made → Contract Requested / Information Verified, or Closed Lost with a reason. Contract Team: stage is updated by DocuSign/automation only. Contact an admin if this is unexpected.
